summary: Read-only review of react-backend.mjs and its host/runtime call sites found no blocking issue. The adapter maps supported Gobi text, fragment, and element nodes; class and true disabled attributes; and declared click paths/Args into React and `{Path, Event, Value}` Go dispatch. Host snapshot validation preserves `{state, tree, messages}` and rejects WASM error objects before cache replacement. Native disabled buttons suppress clicks, callback/render failures disable the adapter and the host fails closed, and unmount clears the React root. Scope remains the documented synchronous counter subset.
